name: BNB Chain MCP Server
description: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact with BNB Chain, opBNB, and other EVM networks through natural language. It provides tools for DeFi trading, DEX swaps, smart contract deployment, token operations, security analysis, and market data across multiple blockchain networks.
